name: HISTORICAL VERDICT -> ORIGINAL -> CORRECTED
question: What did the original instrument say, what does an honest instrument say on the same inputs, and is the difference the instrument or the data?

steps.does: replay the ORIGINAL logic unchanged (Pollux exemplar; NT-001 grading oracle for ladder scores) and record its verdict
instrument-null reading of the original statistic on independent / shuffled / repeated inputs
literal-verdict lint of the original code path: could it have said anything else?
the corrected statistic (labelled NECROPOLIS ADAPTER, never represented as history) on the same inputs
chance floor / constant-responder score for the corrected read

output_contract: {historical_verdict, instrument_null_reading, static_lint, corrected_read, chance_floor, attribution: INSTRUMENT / DATA / BOTH / UNDETERMINED}; the corrected read is filed under the adapter's tool_id, never under the original's
